paite: Pathian i kihumbitna leh i hatna, mangbat lai a huh pahpahpa nai gige ahi.
heading: Korah Tate La / I Kiang Ah Pathian A-om
english: For the Chief Musician. By the sons of Korah. According to Alamoth. God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

paite: Huaiziak in leitung hong kidang in, mualte tuipi sung pek ah kisuan mahleh i lau kei ding uh.
english: Therefore we won’t be afraid, though the earth changes, though the mountains are shaken into the heart of the seas;

paite: Atuite ging honhon in phul butbut mahleh, akihot thupi ziak in mualte ling duamduam mahleh, i lautuan sam kei ding. Selah
english: though its waters roar and are troubled, though the mountains tremble with their swelling. Selah.

paite: Lui khat a-om a, huai luikate'n Pathian khopi akipaksak hi, tungnungpen omna Mun Siangthoupen.
english: There is a river, the streams of which make the city of God glad, the holy place of the tents of the Most High.

paite: Alaitak ah Pathian a-om a, aling kei ding; Pathian in phalvak chiang in apanpih ding hi.
english: God is within her. She shall not be moved. God will help her at dawn.

paite: Namte aging huthut ua, gamte aling a; ama'n a-aw asuah a leitung ahong tui khinta hi.
english: The nations raged. The kingdoms were moved. He lifted his voice and the earth melted.

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA i kiang uah a-om a, Jakob' Pathian i insang ahi. Selah
english: Yahweh of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

paite: Kisa un, TOUPA thilhihte en un, leitung a thil ahihsiatdan.
english: Come, see Yahweh’s works, what desolations he has made on the earth.

paite: Ama'n kidounate kawlmong pha in ahihtawp a; thalpeu ahihtan a, tei asattan hi; kangtalaite mei ah ahalmang hi.
english: He makes wars cease to the end of the earth. He breaks the bow, and shatters the spear. He burns the chariots in the fire.

paite: Dai unla, Pathian ka hi chih thei un; namte lak ah pahtawi in ka om ding, leitung ah pahtawi in ka om ding hi.
english: “Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted on the earth.”

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA i kiang uah a-om a; Jakob' Pathian i insang ahi. Selah
english: Yahweh of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
